turns.text: quick q. check engine light is still on, o2 sensor most likely. shop has me booked saturday so the repair cost is coming, about $238. iris keeps our household budget sheet and i just want to be told where to put it

Happy to help. A one-time car repair usually works best as its own line in a "Car / Transportation" category, rather than being mixed into groceries or utilities. A few quick things would help me tell you exactly where it goes:

1. Does the sheet already have a car or transportation category?
2. Is the car only yours, or do you both use it?
3. How do you two usually split shared costs versus personal ones?

car is mine, i drive it to work. iris has a shared section and then personal stuff. i pay $1,450 of the $2,900 rent so we're even there and i dont want it to get weird. honestly idk what iris would want the line to look like, she's the one who set the whole thing up

Since it's your car and you use it for your commute, the cleanest approach is to treat it as your personal expense, not a shared one. You're already paying your half of the rent, so the shared section stays balanced and this doesn't shift anything.

Here's a simple way to enter it:
- Section: your personal expenses
- Category: Car / Transportation
- Line item: "Car repair - O2 sensor"
- Amount: $238 (change it to the real total after Saturday)
- Date: Saturday's repair date
- Note: "one-time, check engine light"

Because Iris built the sheet, I'd send her a quick message so the format matches what she wants. Something like:

"hey, car repair is coming Saturday, about $238. i was going to put it under my personal car category as a one-time line. does that work or do you want it somewhere else in the sheet?"

That way she decides the layout and you still get the line in.
ok that works. tldr if she wants it in shared how would that look

TLDR for the shared version:
- Put "Car repair - O2 sensor, $238" in the shared section as a one-time item.
- Add a column or note showing who it's charged to, or split it 50/50 ($119 each).
- Only do this if you both agree, since it's your car and rent is already even.

If Iris prefers it your way, personal is simpler. Either way, let her pick the layout.
